warning.bounce: Your hard-bounce rate ({rate}) over the last {days} days is approaching the limit. New broadcasts are being sent at a reduced rate until it recovers.
warning.complaint: Your complaint rate ({rate}) over the last {days} days is approaching the limit. New broadcasts are being sent at a reduced rate until it recovers.

paused.bounce: New API, batch and broadcast sends are paused due to hard bounces: {count} events across {sent} sends ({rate}) today and yesterday in UTC. Review the list and suppressions. See the criteria and recovery steps in metrics.
paused.complaint: New API, batch and broadcast sends are paused due to complaints: {count} events across {sent} sends ({rate}) today and yesterday in UTC. Review contact sources and consent. See the criteria and recovery steps in metrics.

recovery.title: Sending protection and recovery
recovery.pauseWindow: The pause uses today and yesterday in the UTC calendar. This window is separate from the range selected in the charts.
recovery.warningWindow: The warning uses the last {days} days in UTC and reduces broadcast speed. The pause criteria below use a shorter window.
recovery.pauseEvidence: {metric}: {count} events across {sent} sends ({rate}), today and yesterday in UTC.
recovery.warningEvidence: {metric}: a rate of {rate} over the last {days} days in UTC, at warning level.
recovery.criteriaVolume: Today's and yesterday's UTC window must contain at least {sent} sends and meet one of these conditions:
recovery.bounceCriteria: At least {count} hard bounces and a rate at or above {rate}.
recovery.complaintCriteria: At least {count} complaints and a rate at or above {rate}.

steps.list: Fix the list at its source: remove invalid addresses and stop retrying recipients with permanent rejections.
steps.suppressions: Review the actual suppression list. Hard bounces and complaints received from the provider automatically suppress the address. Preserve these entries; removing them to retry keeps the problem in place.
steps.consent: Review contact sources, consent and segmentation. Remove people who did not authorize messages or unsubscribed from campaigns.

recovery.reevaluationAt: Earliest possible calendar review: {date} UTC, if no new sends or events occur. Release depends on a fresh evaluation of the criteria; this time does not guarantee sending will resume.
recovery.reevaluationPending: The next evaluation uses current counters. The window advances at 00:00 UTC. Without enough daily detail, there is no estimated improvement date yet.
recovery.automatic: Sending resumes automatically when the pause criteria are no longer met. New events can change the result; a warning may continue reducing broadcast speed after the pause ends.

sendGuard.bounce: New API, batch and broadcast sends are paused due to hard bounces. Displayed rate: {rate} over {days} days; protection threshold: {limit}. Review the rejected addresses. The evaluation uses today and yesterday in UTC; sending resumes automatically when the pause criteria are no longer met.
sendGuard.complaint: New API, batch and broadcast sends are paused due to complaints. Displayed rate: {rate} over {days} days; protection threshold: {limit}. Review contact sources and consent. The evaluation uses today and yesterday in UTC; sending resumes automatically when the pause criteria are no longer met.
sendGuard.regionPaused: Broadcasts are paused for a short while to protect delivery. Transactional email is unaffected, and broadcasts resume on their own. Try again later.
sendGuard.suspended: This team is suspended by the instance operator. Sending is disabled until it is reinstated.
sendGuard.operatorPaused: Broadcasts are paused for this team by the instance operator. Transactional email is unaffected.
sendGuard.regionHeld: Broadcasts are paused in {region} by the instance operator. Transactional email is unaffected. Try again later.
sendGuard.tooLarge: This audience needs more than {days} days of sending capacity. Split it into smaller segments or contact support.
sendGuard.tooLargeSelfHost: This audience needs more than {days} days of sending capacity. Split it into smaller segments or ask your instance operator for more capacity.
